sources.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
sources.supports: Scalar forgetting with a delta correction; chunkwise parallel training and hybrid variants; normalized queries/keys and additional block components.
sources.layoutDifference: The original uses value-by-key state. This page transposes it to key-by-value to match Kimi Linear equation 1. Scalar forgetting commutes with the rank-one correction.
sources.limits: The local dense affine expansion is an algebra check, not the author's optimized WY algorithm or CUDA kernel.

sources.title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
sources.supports: Channel-wise decay; the order (I - beta k k^T) Diag(alpha); key-by-value state; WY/UT chunk algorithm; a 3:1 KDA/full-MLA hybrid with extra block components.
sources.limits: No Kimi checkpoints or optimized kernels are run. The site's 2x3 example does not reproduce pretraining, RL, retrieval accuracy, KV savings percentages or throughput.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B official model card
sources.version: 9B model card, checked 2026-10-30; see official-card-revision.json for pinned text identity
locations: Model Overview / Language Model / Hidden Layout
sources.supports: The 9B card explicitly lists 8 repeats of 3 Gated DeltaNet plus 1 Gated Attention layer, with FFN after each mixer.
sources.limits: This is the named 9B model, not a claim about every Qwen3.5 model. It uses GDN, not KDA; full attention is not Kimi Linear's MLA. Do not infer private training recipes from an architecture card.

localScope: Thirty local finite-difference derivatives, all eight chunk partitions of a four-token recurrence, fixed gate/order/gradient counterexamples, and an abstract scalar-slot ledger. No complete model or GPU benchmark.
